nom: SimplyVital Face Moisturizer Retinol Collagen Hyaluronic Acid Cream 1.7 oz

segments.oily: Several reviewers with oily skin or an oily T-zone found the cream too heavy, reporting increased shine, a need to wipe their face after waking, or breakouts, while a couple of others with an oily T-zone said it absorbed without feeling greasy.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including some with eczema, consistently report significant hydration and relief from dry, tight or flaking patches.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin are split: one reports it worked well within a skin-cycling routine, while others say it made their oilier zones oilier and triggered breakouts.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin, including some with rosacea or eczema, report no irritation and credit the fragrance-free formula, though a few sensitive-skin users describe stinging, redness or breakouts.
segments.normal: One reviewer describing their skin as normal to dry reports strong, fairly fast hydrating results.
segments.mature: Reviewers who describe their skin as mature report reduced fine lines, less visible texture and a firmer look over several weeks, though one felt the retinol percentage was too low to make a real difference for more advanced aging.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers report visibly reduced fine lines and wrinkles, smoother texture and a firmer look after two to several weeks of use; one reviewer felt the retinol percentage is too low to make a meaningful difference for more advanced signs of aging.
concerns.dehydration: Hydration is the most consistently reported benefit, with reviewers describing softer, plumper, dewy skin that lasts through the day or night; a couple of reviewers say it did not keep their skin hydrated all day or left their T-zone under-moisturized.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with rosacea or general redness report calmer, less red skin with no flare-ups, but at least two describe a severe reaction with burning, swelling and spreading redness after only a few uses.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report that dark spots, hyperpigmentation, sun spots or old scars faded or lightened with continued use.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report no new breakouts or fewer blackheads and whiteheads, and some describe small initial breakouts they attribute to purging that resolved with continued use; a few, including one who found the cream too thick, report it caused new blemishes.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers disagree on oiliness: several with oily skin or an oily T-zone say the cream made their skin oilier or shinier, while others with an oily T-zone report it absorbed without an oily finish.

aspects.libelle: Pump dispenser seen as hygienic and precise
Pump mechanism frequently clogs, leaks or stops working
Jar perceived to hold far less product than its size suggests
Seen as good value for the price versus pricier brands, though a few find it overpriced for a basic moisturizer

extraits.texte: I used this product TWICE. Once the night I got it and Once the next morning. I started noticing as the day went on, that my neck was burning like it had a sun burn. Didn't think anything of it at first, but as the day went on it started getting worse, to a point of being uncomfortable. I took an antihistamine, used hydrocortisone cream and just couldn't figure out what was happening. It started getting puffy and swollen and was super sensitive to the touch and started spreading up my face. Then it dawned on me....I started using this stuff...only thing I've done different in two days. Started reading the poor reviews and sure enough....I'm not the only one that has experienced this. I've used all kinds of products, both OTC and scripted, had treatments of all sorts and have never had a reaction like this. BEWARE!!!

extraits.titre: Too thick and broke my face out
extraits.texte: I wanted this to work but reminds me not to follow tick tock trends. Product is too thick seems might clog pores whatever the case my skin was clear and skin tone was clearing up the best it’s been in years.. after using this my pimples started popping up on the right side of my face and I don’t sleep on the right side of my face. Only new routine is this thick lotion. Cons: 1. The top squeezer stopped working after a few days use. 2. Too thick possibly clog pores 3. Bad skin reaction causing new blemishes on skin. 4. Lost money and time 5. Now have to even my skin tone again. Pros: lesson learned Update: 11/24/23 Although this didn’t work for my skin. The company did make it right with my investment. Much appreciated and respect.

extraits.texte: I wish we could see what's in the ingredients prior to purchasing the product. I don't expect miracles and did read the reviews. This is simply just a moisturizer. It does tell you what it has it it such as Collagen, retinol and hyaluronic acid, but it doesn't tell you the percentage of anything especially retinol. So I really don't know how strong it is. It is overpriced for what it is. It's not a scammy item, but it's not an anti-aging skin cream at all. And if you're sensitive such as acne prone, with the amount of oil that's in there, such as coconut oil being high on the ingredient list, you might get some irritation. So with that, I returned it. This is why I wish they would put a clear label of the ingredient list prior to purchasing.

I like how the packaging is made so the entire container of product is not contaminated every time you go to use it. With the current design, it expels an average amount of the cream. My face feels moisturized when I use this cream without the need to reapply throughout the day, however, it might be a little heavy for people with oil skin. I have oily to combination skin so it made me break out after using it. It took me over a month to get used to the product before using it everyday. I am not too sure about the anti-aging effects, but my skin does feel more moisturized nowadays.

I have been using Simply Vitals Collagen, Retinol and Hyaluronic Acid Cream for about 2 weeks. It's proven by science and contains Collagen, Retinol 3%, Hyaluronic Acid, Vitamin E, Avocado Oil and Jojoba oil. It is also lactose, gluten, sulfate, paraban, gmo free and non comedogenic. I really like the bottle, it has a push pump that allows you to get the appropriate amount of product so it's hard to waste. The bottle also clearly shows an expiration date. This is made in the USA. The texture of the cream is nice, it's no heavy or too thick and there is no fragrance. Over the last 2 weeks we have battled Artic temperatures (-30 windchill) and my skin has been really dry. This is an excellent moisturizer. I can literally feel my skin being hydrated. I've noticed that my forehead wrinkles are not as predominant as well as my crows feet. It makes my skin glowy. I have mature skin that has texture and large pores on my nose. I do believe that over the next 2-3 months of continuing to use this, all of my concerns will improve....I just need to be patient. I would definitely recommend this product. It can be purchased on Amazon for about $22. @simplyvital.us #collagencream #glowyskin

I'm ashamed to admit that I've spent a lot of money on skincare--everything from drugstore to premium brands to prescriptions from my dermatologist. While everyone's skin is different, this is the product that works best for me. (I am in my 50's with paper thin, dry, extra sensitive skin.) There was one other retinol product that my skin was able to tolerate, but this worked even better and was a better value. I had a couple of superficial scars on my face that had been there for more than a year, both of which were gone by the time I finished my first jar of this. My sun spots seem to be slowly lightening up a bit. My skin just looks better. It's not a facelift in a jar, but I can see that it makes a difference over time and I appreciate it. I also appreciate that there's no burning or itching; this cream goes on like a luxury moisturizer, yet works like what it is: the maximum amount of retinol available over the counter. Plus, it lasts and it's made here in the U.S. Wishing you your very best skin at the very best price!

I have really sensitive skin and have had a hard time finding a product with retinol in it that doesn’t burn. This one has worked wonders for me, minimal redness and no irritation. My skin genuinely feels smoother, I had some minor breakouts at first but I believe this was skin purging, after my skin is noticeably smoother and makeup is applying better as well! My wedding is in a few months and I can’t wait to see how my skin has improved by then. Love this product and will be repurchasing!
